Troubleshooting · BEGINNER FRIENDLY · 3 MIN READ

iPhone or iPad won’t connect to Wi-Fi

Tech Compass · Updated 2026-10-19

IN THIS GUIDE

The quick answer1. Confirm the connection2. Restart and compare3. Try another networkBefore resetting network settingsFurther reading
THE QUICK ANSWER

Check Settings → Wi-Fi first. A checkmark beside a network means you joined it, but does not guarantee internet access. Compare with another device on the same network.

1. Confirm the connection

Open Settings → Wi-Fi, turn Wi-Fi on, and select your network. Check the password carefully. Move within range of the router.

2. Restart and compare

Restart your iPhone or iPad. If other devices also cannot connect, restart the router when it is safe to interrupt the household connection. Test again.

3. Try another network

If the device works on another trusted Wi-Fi network, investigate the original router or internet service. If it cannot connect anywhere, contact Apple Support.

Before resetting network settings

A network reset removes saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords and resets cellular, VPN, and APN settings. Keep this as a later step, following Apple’s current instructions. Ask your administrator first on a managed device.
